name: breakpoint
description: Programmatic breakpoint - like JavaScript's "debugger;" statement. Suspends execution when a debugger is attached, allowing inspection of variables. Returns true if breakpoint was hit, false if skipped.

params.name: label
params.description: Optional label to identify this breakpoint in the debugger UI.

params.name: condition
params.description: When true, execution suspends. Use for conditional breakpoints.
